titulo: Demonstrative adjectives to refer to time
subtitulo: Esta semana, ese día, aquellos años.
regla: Este = this (present or near future): esta semana. Ese = that (past or future): ese día. Aquel = that, far in the past, often nostalgic: aquellos tiempos. Aquel is never used for the present or future.

bloques.texto: Demonstratives point in **space**, but also in **time**.

filas: the distant past only, often with nostalgia

bloques.texto: Choosing **ese** or **aquel** for the past is partly subjective: **aquel** feels further away.
Tip: **este** is here, **ese** is there, **aquel** is a memory.

lista.es: ==Esta== semana no ha parado de llover.
lista.en: It hasn't stopped raining this week.

lista.es: ==Estos== meses va a seguir subiendo el desempleo.
lista.en: Unemployment will keep rising in the coming months.
I have a lot of work this month. (now or the coming month)

lista.es: ==Ese== día estaba muy enferma y no vine a trabajar.
lista.en: I was very sick that day and didn't come to work.

lista.es: Recuerdo ==ese== día como algo muy especial.
lista.en: I remember that day as something very special.
Will you have more time that day?

lista.es: ¡Qué tiempos ==aquellos==, cuando no había celulares y se platicaba más!
lista.en: What times those were, when there were no cell phones and people talked more!
What a week we spent on Holbox!
What great memories I have of that trip! (feels closer)
What great memories I have of that trip! (feels far away)

filas.t: El viernes hay junta. ¿Vas a tener tiempo aquel día?
El viernes hay junta. ¿Vas a tener tiempo ese día?

lista.texto: The present for the future: [[5094|este, esta]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: Complete: _En ___ época (far past) vivíamos en Tijuana._
Complete: ____ fin de semana (the coming one) voy a surfear._
Can you say _aquel día de mañana_?
lista.r: No: aquel is only for the past.
